why: Alcoa's own 3Q26 announcement (IR CDN, path dated 2026/Sep/15) sets results after the NYSE close on 2026-10-15, with a call at 17:00 EDT.
session_evidence: Company announcement: results after the NYSE close on 2026-10-15, call at 5:00 p.m. EDT the same day. https://s29.q4cdn.com/844074237/files/doc_news/2026/Sep/15/3Q26-EarningsAnnouncement.pdf
where_to_look: Western Australia, Pinjarra: WA EPA and state regulator notices, mine-approval status and local press (Peel/Mandurah) on operating disruptions since July. The 2026 alumina production guide (9.5-9.6Mt) was cut once on Pinjarra and could be cut again.
South32 asset acquisition ($4.1B): financing terms, any equity component, regulatory approvals (FIRB, ACCC) and closing timing. The dilution overhang was cited as a driver of the Q2 drop.
Q3 Midwest premium and LME aluminium path against alumina index (API) prices; the Q2 release's Q3 sensitivities give the arithmetic.
Spanish San Ciprián and Norway/Iceland smelter energy-cost or curtailment news.

Q3 operational tax expense guided at $80-90M
